attchmntText: EIH Associated Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about Acquisition
voiceSummary: EIH Associated Hotels Limited has approved an investment of up to 26% in the paid-up capital of M/s Avaada Indsolar Private Limited. The Board of Directors authorized this acquisition during its meeting on 11th November 2026. The investment is for cash consideration at Rs. 10 per share, with a maximum cost of Rs. 0.46 crores. This stake corresponds to the company's ownership in a 1 MWac or 1.3 MWdc solar power plant. The move complies with the Electricity Act, 2003, which mandates captive users hold at least 26% equity in the special purpose vehicle. The transaction aims to secure dedicated renewable electricity for hotel operations. Completion is expected by March 2027. Avaada Indsolar Private Limited was incorporated on 29th June 2021. It is not a related party transaction.

attchmntText: EIH Associated Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: EIH Associated Hotels Limited has updated the opening date for 10 luxury tents at Hotel Trident, Udaipur. The tents were originally scheduled to open on 1st October 2026. The new opening date is 1st October 2027. This information is submitted under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The company code is EIHAHOTELS on the National Stock Exchange of India Limited. The BSE code is 523127. The announcement was issued on 11th November 2026. Tejasvi Dixit, Company Secretary, signed the letter for EIH Associated Hotels Limited.

attchmntText: EIH Associated Hotels Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: EIH Associated Hotels Limited reported unaudited financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results on 11 November 2026. Revenue from operations was 6,859.17 Lakhs. Profit after tax stood at 379.55 Lakhs. Earnings per share were 0.62 Rupees. For the half year ended 30 September 2026, revenue from operations was 13,457.16 Lakhs. Profit after tax was 1,069.04 Lakhs. Earnings per share were 1.75 Rupees. Total assets as at 30 September 2026 were 71,394.05 Lakhs. Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP issued a limited review report on the standalone financial results.
